techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-40-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames inspected in six paired native sheets, covering nine equipped moves/front+side, windup, strike/cast/rest, recovery and idle. Snout, white jaw/cheeks, eyes, ears and headband remain stable. Arms, feet and tail move with torso; whole-body motion in strikes remains connected.

limits: Local exact-hash visual review. Production companion techniques use battle mesh only, not source override. Raw normal attachments reveal surfaces without changing geometry, skin or animation; Some throat surfaces are covered by the gi collar; visible snout/chin checked from front, both sides and underneath. No live delivery or authenticated modal claim. One fresh216-frame technique capture reviewed, not an independent second timing capture.

faceNormals.method: Raw QA renderer with surface-normal fragment material; same geometry/skin/animation/camera, no asset edit
